content.json:
## N2W Azure Backup Estate Audit
Counts your VMs, what's backed up, your vaults and policies, and the reporting plumbing around them, then prices it at list.

**Read-only.** It runs as you, with Reader, using Azure Resource Graph queries you can read in the Advanced editor. It creates nothing and sends nothing outside your tenant. The only thing that ever leaves is the summary line on the last tab, and only if you paste it somewhere yourself.

<sub>v1.0.9 · prices: Azure list, East US, retrieved 2 Nov 2026 · source and license: github.com/N2W-Software/azure-backup-audit</sub>

parameters.name: ProdTagKey
parameters.label: Prod tag key
parameters.description: Tag key that marks production VMs (case-insensitive)

parameters.name: ProdTagValue
parameters.label: Prod tag value
parameters.description: Matches values that start with this, e.g. prod, production

parameters.name: UsedRatio
parameters.label: Used ÷ provisioned disk, %
parameters.description: Azure bills the instance fee on used data; Resource Graph only sees provisioned size. 100 = upper bound for the fee.

parameters.name: N2WStorage
parameters.label: N2W storage tier
parameters.jsonData: [{"value": "0.0152", "label": "Cool LRS \u00b7 $0.0152/GB"}, {"value": "0.019", "label": "Cool ZRS \u00b7 $0.019/GB"}, {"value": "0.0334", "label": "Cool GRS \u00b7 $0.0334/GB"}, {"value": "0.0036", "label": "Cold LRS \u00b7 $0.0036/GB"}, {"value": "0.004", "label": "Cold ZRS \u00b7 $0.004/GB"}, {"value": "0.0081", "label": "Cold GRS \u00b7 $0.0081/GB"}]

parameters.name: N2WServer
parameters.label: N2W server VM, $/month
parameters.description: The VM N2W runs on, in your subscription. 0 = left out; enter your size's monthly cost.

parameters.name: C_ProtVms
parameters.label: Protected VMs
parameters.query:
Resources
| where type =~ 'microsoft.compute/virtualmachines'
| extend vmId = tolower(id)
| extend isProd = tolower(tostring(tags)) contains tolower(strcat('"', '{ProdTagKey}', '":"', '{ProdTagValue}'))
| extend os = tostring(properties.storageProfile.osDisk.osType), vmSize = tostring(properties.hardwareProfile.vmSize)
| project vmId, id, name, subscriptionId, resourceGroup, location, os, vmSize, isProd
| join kind=leftouter (
    Resources
    | where type =~ 'microsoft.compute/disks' and isnotempty(managedBy)
    | summarize provGB = sum(toint(properties.diskSizeGB)) by vmId = tolower(tostring(managedBy))
  ) on vmId
| join kind=leftouter (
    RecoveryServicesResources
    | where type =~ 'microsoft.recoveryservices/vaults/backupfabrics/protectioncontainers/protecteditems'
    | where tostring(properties.backupManagementType) =~ 'AzureIaasVM'
    | where tostring(properties.currentProtectionState) in~ ('ProtectionConfigured','ConfiguringProtection','ProtectionError','ConfiguringProtectionFailed','IRPending')
    | extend vmId = tolower(tostring(properties.sourceResourceId))
    | extend vaultPart = tostring(split(tolower(id), '/providers/microsoft.recoveryservices/vaults/')[1])
    | summarize vaults = make_set(tostring(split(vaultPart, '/')[0])), policies = make_set(tostring(properties.policyName)) by vmId
  ) on vmId
| extend provGB = iff(isnull(provGB), 0, provGB)
| extend protected = coalesce(array_length(vaults), 0) > 0
| extend vault = tostring(vaults[0]), policy = tostring(policies[0])
| extend usedGB = todouble(provGB) * {UsedRatio} / 100.0
| extend piUnits = iff(usedGB <= 50, 0.5, ceiling(usedGB / 500.0))
| extend piFee = iff(usedGB <= 50, todouble({PiSmall}), {PiUnit} * ceiling(usedGB / 500.0))
| extend band = case(usedGB <= 50, '1 · up to 50 GB', usedGB <= 500, '2 · 50–500 GB', usedGB <= 1000, '3 · 0.5–1 TB', usedGB <= 2000, '4 · 1–2 TB', '5 · over 2 TB')
| where protected
| summarize n = count()
| project v = tostring(n)

parameters.name: C_Sql
parameters.label: SQL instances
parameters.query:
RecoveryServicesResources
| where type =~ 'microsoft.recoveryservices/vaults/backupfabrics/protectioncontainers/protecteditems'
| where tostring(properties.backupManagementType) =~ 'AzureWorkload' and tostring(properties.workloadType) =~ 'SQLDataBase'

parameters.name: VaultStorageTB
parameters.label: Vault storage used, TB
parameters.description: auto = estimate from provisioned disk (often well off). Click each vault on tab 2, add up its storage, and type the total in TB.

parameters.name: C_VsTB
parameters.label: Vault storage in use, TB
parameters.query:
ResourceContainers
| where type =~ 'microsoft.resources/subscriptions'
| take 1
| project v = tostring(round(iff('{VaultStorageTB}' =~ 'auto', coalesce(todouble('{C_ProtGB}'), 0.0) / 1024.0, coalesce(todouble('{VaultStorageTB}'), 0.0)), 2))

content.json:
The price boxes above are the assumptions behind tab 3. Defaults are Azure list prices for East US on 2 Nov 2026; type your negotiated rates and everything recalculates.

- **Instance fee:** up to 50 GB $5; then $10 per started 500 GB. Billed on used data; this workbook sees provisioned size, so lower *Used ÷ provisioned* if your disks are half empty.
- **N2W storage tier:** Cool has a 30-day minimum, Cold a 90-day minimum plus per-GB retrieval. Compare like with like: GRS vaults against a GRS tier.
- **Vault storage** isn't in Resource Graph. The default is the protected VMs' provisioned disk × *Used ÷ provisioned*, which can be far off: in testing it was 5× the real figure. Click each vault on tab 2 to see its actual storage and type the total into *Vault storage used*. The script in the same repo reads it automatically.

content.query:
Resources
| where type =~ 'microsoft.compute/virtualmachines'
| extend vmId = tolower(id)
| extend isProd = tolower(tostring(tags)) contains tolower(strcat('"', '{ProdTagKey}', '":"', '{ProdTagValue}'))
| extend os = tostring(properties.storageProfile.osDisk.osType), vmSize = tostring(properties.hardwareProfile.vmSize)
| project vmId, id, name, subscriptionId, resourceGroup, location, os, vmSize, isProd
| join kind=leftouter (
    Resources
    | where type =~ 'microsoft.compute/disks' and isnotempty(managedBy)
    | summarize provGB = sum(toint(properties.diskSizeGB)) by vmId = tolower(tostring(managedBy))
  ) on vmId
| join kind=leftouter (
    RecoveryServicesResources
    | where type =~ 'microsoft.recoveryservices/vaults/backupfabrics/protectioncontainers/protecteditems'
    | where tostring(properties.backupManagementType) =~ 'AzureIaasVM'
    | where tostring(properties.currentProtectionState) in~ ('ProtectionConfigured','ConfiguringProtection','ProtectionError','ConfiguringProtectionFailed','IRPending')
    | extend vmId = tolower(tostring(properties.sourceResourceId))
    | extend vaultPart = tostring(split(tolower(id), '/providers/microsoft.recoveryservices/vaults/')[1])
    | summarize vaults = make_set(tostring(split(vaultPart, '/')[0])), policies = make_set(tostring(properties.policyName)) by vmId
  ) on vmId
| extend provGB = iff(isnull(provGB), 0, provGB)
| extend protected = coalesce(array_length(vaults), 0) > 0
| extend vault = tostring(vaults[0]), policy = tostring(policies[0])
| extend usedGB = todouble(provGB) * {UsedRatio} / 100.0
| extend piUnits = iff(usedGB <= 50, 0.5, ceiling(usedGB / 500.0))
| extend piFee = iff(usedGB <= 50, todouble({PiSmall}), {PiUnit} * ceiling(usedGB / 500.0))
| extend band = case(usedGB <= 50, '1 · up to 50 GB', usedGB <= 500, '2 · 50–500 GB', usedGB <= 1000, '3 · 0.5–1 TB', usedGB <= 2000, '4 · 1–2 TB', '5 · over 2 TB')
| summarize vms = count(), prot = countif(protected), unprot = countif(not(protected)), unprotProd = countif(not(protected) and isProd)
| extend p = pack_array(
    pack('k', '00', 'label', 'Azure VMs', 'value', todouble(vms)),
    pack('k', '01', 'label', 'Backed up by Azure Backup', 'value', todouble(prot)),
    pack('k', '02', 'label', 'No backup', 'value', todouble(unprot)),
    pack('k', '03', 'label', 'No backup, tagged prod', 'value', todouble(unprotProd)))
| mv-expand p
| project k = tostring(p.k), label = tostring(p.label), value = todouble(p.value)
| order by k asc

Resources
| where type in~ ('microsoft.compute/disks', 'microsoft.compute/snapshots', 'microsoft.compute/restorepointcollections')
| extend isUn = type =~ 'microsoft.compute/disks' and tostring(properties.diskState) =~ 'Unattached'
| extend isSnap = type =~ 'microsoft.compute/snapshots'
| extend unGB = iff(isUn, toint(properties.diskSizeGB), 0)
| extend snapGB = iff(isSnap, toint(properties.diskSizeGB), 0)
| extend snapAt = iff(isSnap, todatetime(properties.timeCreated), datetime(null))
| summarize unattached = countif(isUn), unattachedGB = sum(unGB), snaps = countif(isSnap), snapGB = sum(snapGB), oldest = min(snapAt), rpc = countif(type =~ 'microsoft.compute/restorepointcollections')
| extend oldestDays = iff(isnull(oldest), 0, toint(datetime_diff('day', now(), oldest)))
| extend p = pack_array(
    pack('k', '00', 'label', 'Unattached disks', 'value', todouble(unattached)),
    pack('k', '01', 'label', 'Unattached disk GB', 'value', todouble(unattachedGB)),
    pack('k', '02', 'label', 'Standalone snapshots', 'value', todouble(snaps)),
    pack('k', '03', 'label', 'Oldest snapshot, days', 'value', todouble(oldestDays)))
| mv-expand p
| project k = tostring(p.k), label = tostring(p.label), value = todouble(p.value)
| order by k asc

Resources
| where type in~ ('microsoft.sqlvirtualmachine/sqlvirtualmachines', 'microsoft.sql/servers/databases')
| where not(type =~ 'microsoft.sql/servers/databases' and name =~ 'master')
| summarize sqlVms = countif(type =~ 'microsoft.sqlvirtualmachine/sqlvirtualmachines'), sqlDbPaas = countif(type =~ 'microsoft.sql/servers/databases')
| extend p = pack_array(
    pack('k', '00', 'label', 'SQL Server VMs (registered)', 'value', todouble(sqlVms)),
    pack('k', '01', 'label', 'Azure SQL databases (PaaS)', 'value', todouble(sqlDbPaas)))
| mv-expand p
| project k = tostring(p.k), label = tostring(p.label), value = todouble(p.value)
| order by k asc

RecoveryServicesResources
| where type =~ 'microsoft.recoveryservices/vaults/backupfabrics/protectioncontainers/protecteditems'
| where tostring(properties.backupManagementType) =~ 'AzureWorkload' and tostring(properties.workloadType) =~ 'SQLDataBase'
| where tostring(properties.currentProtectionState) in~ ('ProtectionConfigured','ConfiguringProtection','ProtectionError','ConfiguringProtectionFailed','IRPending')
| extend inst = strcat(tostring(split(tolower(id), '/protecteditems/')[0]), '|', tolower(tostring(properties.parentName)))
| summarize sqlInstances = dcount(inst), sqlDbs = count()
| extend p = pack_array(
    pack('k', '00', 'label', 'SQL instances backed up in VMs', 'value', todouble(sqlInstances)),
    pack('k', '01', 'label', 'SQL databases backed up', 'value', todouble(sqlDbs)))
| mv-expand p
| project k = tostring(p.k), label = tostring(p.label), value = todouble(p.value)
| order by k asc

content.json: <sub>SQL Server VMs are counted when they're registered with the SQL IaaS Agent extension (the default for Azure Marketplace SQL images); SQL installed by hand on a plain VM won't show here.</sub>

content.json: Azure Backup needs one vault per region, a policy per vault, and a diagnostic setting per vault before Backup Reports can see it; emailed reports add a Logic App. This tab counts what that adds up to in your tenant.

content.query:
Resources
| where type in~ ('microsoft.recoveryservices/vaults', 'microsoft.dataprotection/backupvaults')
    or (type =~ 'microsoft.logic/workflows' and tolower(tostring(tags)) contains '"usedbybackupreports":"true"')
| extend isRs = type =~ 'microsoft.recoveryservices/vaults', isBv = type =~ 'microsoft.dataprotection/backupvaults'
| extend isRpt = type =~ 'microsoft.logic/workflows'
| extend vloc = iff(isRpt, '', location)
| summarize rs = countif(isRs), bv = countif(isBv), rpt = countif(isRpt), locs = dcount(vloc)
| extend vaultRegions = locs - iff(rpt > 0, 1, 0)
| extend p = pack_array(
    pack('k', '00', 'label', 'Recovery Services vaults', 'value', todouble(rs)),
    pack('k', '01', 'label', 'Backup vaults', 'value', todouble(bv)),
    pack('k', '02', 'label', 'Regions with a vault', 'value', todouble(vaultRegions)),
    pack('k', '03', 'label', 'Report Logic Apps (UsedByBackupReports)', 'value', todouble(rpt)))
| mv-expand p
| project k = tostring(p.k), label = tostring(p.label), value = todouble(p.value)
| order by k asc

RecoveryServicesResources
| where type in~ ('microsoft.recoveryservices/vaults/backuppolicies', 'microsoft.recoveryservices/vaults/backupjobs', 'microsoft.recoveryservices/vaults/backupfabrics/protectioncontainers/protecteditems')
| extend isPol = type =~ 'microsoft.recoveryservices/vaults/backuppolicies'
| extend polId = iff(isPol, tolower(id), '')
| join kind=leftouter (
    RecoveryServicesResources
    | where type =~ 'microsoft.recoveryservices/vaults/backupfabrics/protectioncontainers/protecteditems' and isnotempty(tostring(properties.policyId))
    | summarize usedBy = count() by polId = tolower(tostring(properties.policyId))
  ) on polId
| extend isDefault = isPol and name in~ ('DefaultPolicy', 'HourlyLogBackup', 'EnhancedPolicy')
| extend isUnused = isPol and isnull(usedBy) and not(isDefault)
| extend isUnusedDefault = isPol and isnull(usedBy) and isDefault

ResourceContainers
| where type =~ 'microsoft.resources/subscriptions'

| extend r = pack_array(
    pack('k', 'a1', 'side', 'Azure Backup', 'line', 'Protected-instance fees', 'math', strcat('{C_ProtVms} VMs = {C_PiUnits} fee units × $', '{PiUnit}', ' (up to 50 GB counts as half)'), 'usd', round(todouble(coalesce(todouble('{C_PiFee}'), 0.0)), 0)),
    pack('k', 'a2', 'side', 'Azure Backup', 'line', 'SQL Server in VM', 'math', strcat('{C_Sql} instances × $', '{SqlFee}', ' (lowest tier)'), 'usd', round(todouble(coalesce(todouble('{C_Sql}'), 0.0) * coalesce(todouble('{SqlFee}'), 0.0)), 0)),
    pack('k', 'a3', 'side', 'Azure Backup', 'line', 'Vault storage', 'math', strcat('{C_VsTB} TB', iff('{VaultStorageTB}' =~ 'auto', ' (estimate)', ''), ' × $', '{BackupStorage}', '/GB'), 'usd', round(todouble(coalesce(todouble('{C_VsTB}'), 0.0) * 1024 * coalesce(todouble('{BackupStorage}'), 0.0)), 0)),
    pack('k', 'a9', 'side', 'Azure Backup', 'line', 'Total per month', 'math', 'excludes instant-restore snapshots and Log Analytics ingestion', 'usd', round(todouble((coalesce(todouble('{C_PiFee}'), 0.0) + coalesce(todouble('{C_Sql}'), 0.0) * coalesce(todouble('{SqlFee}'), 0.0) + coalesce(todouble('{C_VsTB}'), 0.0) * 1024 * coalesce(todouble('{BackupStorage}'), 0.0))), 0)),
    pack('k', 'n1', 'side', 'N2W', 'line', 'License, flat', 'math', strcat('{C_ProtVms} VMs × $', '{N2WLicense}', ', SQL included'), 'usd', round(todouble(coalesce(todouble('{C_ProtVms}'), 0.0) * coalesce(todouble('{N2WLicense}'), 0.0)), 0)),

    pack('k', 'n3', 'side', 'N2W', 'line', 'N2W server VM', 'math', 'as entered in Pricing', 'usd', round(todouble(coalesce(todouble('{N2WServer}'), 0.0)), 0)),
    pack('k', 'n9', 'side', 'N2W', 'line', 'Total per month', 'math', 'excludes snapshots and storage transactions, same as above', 'usd', round(todouble((coalesce(todouble('{C_ProtVms}'), 0.0) * coalesce(todouble('{N2WLicense}'), 0.0) + coalesce(todouble('{C_VsTB}'), 0.0) * 1024 * coalesce(todouble('{N2WStorage}'), 0.0) + coalesce(todouble('{N2WServer}'), 0.0))), 0)))

content.query:
Resources
| where type =~ 'microsoft.compute/virtualmachines'
| extend vmId = tolower(id)
| extend isProd = tolower(tostring(tags)) contains tolower(strcat('"', '{ProdTagKey}', '":"', '{ProdTagValue}'))
| extend os = tostring(properties.storageProfile.osDisk.osType), vmSize = tostring(properties.hardwareProfile.vmSize)
| project vmId, id, name, subscriptionId, resourceGroup, location, os, vmSize, isProd
| join kind=leftouter (
    Resources
    | where type =~ 'microsoft.compute/disks' and isnotempty(managedBy)
    | summarize provGB = sum(toint(properties.diskSizeGB)) by vmId = tolower(tostring(managedBy))
  ) on vmId
| join kind=leftouter (
    RecoveryServicesResources
    | where type =~ 'microsoft.recoveryservices/vaults/backupfabrics/protectioncontainers/protecteditems'
    | where tostring(properties.backupManagementType) =~ 'AzureIaasVM'
    | where tostring(properties.currentProtectionState) in~ ('ProtectionConfigured','ConfiguringProtection','ProtectionError','ConfiguringProtectionFailed','IRPending')
    | extend vmId = tolower(tostring(properties.sourceResourceId))
    | extend vaultPart = tostring(split(tolower(id), '/providers/microsoft.recoveryservices/vaults/')[1])
    | summarize vaults = make_set(tostring(split(vaultPart, '/')[0])), policies = make_set(tostring(properties.policyName)) by vmId
  ) on vmId
| extend provGB = iff(isnull(provGB), 0, provGB)
| extend protected = coalesce(array_length(vaults), 0) > 0
| extend vault = tostring(vaults[0]), policy = tostring(policies[0])
| extend usedGB = todouble(provGB) * {UsedRatio} / 100.0
| extend piUnits = iff(usedGB <= 50, 0.5, ceiling(usedGB / 500.0))
| extend piFee = iff(usedGB <= 50, todouble({PiSmall}), {PiUnit} * ceiling(usedGB / 500.0))
| extend band = case(usedGB <= 50, '1 · up to 50 GB', usedGB <= 500, '2 · 50–500 GB', usedGB <= 1000, '3 · 0.5–1 TB', usedGB <= 2000, '4 · 1–2 TB', '5 · over 2 TB')
| where protected
| summarize VMs = count(), FeeEach = max(piFee), FeeTotal = sum(piFee) by Band = band
| order by Band asc
